# Alerus recognized as top financial institution in Waukesha County


##### October 30, 2026


Alerus has been recognized by BusinessRate as a Top 3 Financial Institution in Waukesha County for 2026, based on BusinessRate’s benchmark score.


The recognition reflects Alerus’ online customer review performance in the Pewaukee and Waukesha County, Wisconsin, markets. As of October 2026, Alerus ranked No. 1 in Pewaukee for both all-time and recent reviews and No. 3 among 11 financial institutions in Waukesha County overall.


According to BusinessRate, Alerus has ranked No. 1 in Pewaukee for nine consecutive months. In October, Alerus had a BusinessRate score of 195.1, an increase of 19 points from September.
